purpose: Machine-readable audit proving that no known P0 product/code blocker remains before the consolidated manual/external acceptance block. It does not replace E3-E8 acceptance or change official go-live readiness.

external_evidence.description: Final contracting entity, providers, retention/transfer facts and legal review remain external acceptance evidence; the repository contains a review candidate and must not claim legal approval.
dev.bcsentinel.com and dev-api.bcsentinel.com must be verified against the merged acceptance stack.
Real Stripe checkout/webhooks/portal/invoice paths and real SMTP/SPF/DKIM/DMARC delivery evidence remain required.
A real off-host backup restore with observed RTO/RPO remains required even though the PostgreSQL CI restore drill is green.
The 24-hour/50-tenant real infrastructure soak remains required.

manual_acceptance: E4 real Stripe and SMTP/DNS provider acceptance
E5 real off-host backup/restore and RTO/RPO evidence
E6 real pilot end-to-end journey including multi-tenant switching
